params.body:
The print PDFs in the repository root (booklet, mold inserts, price lists, letter) are built from the HTML in `print-src/`, but the steps that build them were never committed. A text change in the booklet source could therefore not be followed by a rebuild. This adds those steps as one script.

## `scripts/build-print.sh`

- Chrome prints each HTML file to PDF at the page size its `@page` rule sets.
- Ghostscript turns all text into outlines (`-dNoOutputFonts`), so a printer's preflight finds no fonts.
- The A5 sources are drawn at 160 x 222 mm. From that one render come two files: `NAME.pdf` cut to plain A5 and `NAME_PRINT.pdf` cut to A5 plus 3 mm bleed, with the trim box marking the A5 inside.
- `scripts/build-print.sh booklet` builds only the sources with "booklet" in their name; `OUT=/some/dir` writes elsewhere, to try a build without touching the repository.
- Meant for a Mac with Google Chrome and Ghostscript. Chrome on Linux lays the same HTML out with other line breaks and uneven letter spacing.

## Checked

Run on Linux into a separate folder and compared with the eleven PDFs in the repository:

- Same page counts; page sizes equal to within 0.01 pt.
- The `_PRINT` files carry the same trim box, on every page.
- No fonts in any file.
- File sizes within about 10 percent, so images are not downsampled.
- The price list's print page lines up with the current one.

Not checked: the rendering of the type, which only a Mac run shows. No PDF in the repository is changed by this pull request.
params.title: Print: a script that builds the print PDFs from print-src
